outcome: Types of congenital birth defects (categorized by ICD10th Revision)
Detection timing of defects (antenatal sonography vs. post-delivery)
cohort: All intramural deliveries after 22 weeks of gestation at B.P. Koirala Institute of Health Sciences, Dharan, from July 2016 to December 2016.
finding: The prevalence of congenital birth defects was 0.4%, with central nervous system defects being the most common (46.15%), and the majority of affected babies (84.6%) were alive at birth and non-lethal.
mod_finding: Majority of babies with birth defects (73.0%) were born vaginally.
birth_weight: Observed; majority (69.2%) had normal birth weight
